prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
For most businesses, **Creatify** is probably the best all-around AI video ad maker because it is built specifically for performance ads: you can paste in a product URL, generate multiple ad concepts, use AI avatars/UGC-style creators, add hooks, captions, voiceovers, and quickly produce variants for TikTok, Meta, and Shorts.

### Best options by use case

| Best for | Tool | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **Overall ecommerce/performance ads** | **Creatify** | Product-URL-to-video workflow, ad-script generation, UGC-style ads, rapid creative variations |
| **Realistic UGC creator ads** | **Arcads** | Strong focus on AI actors delivering direct-response/UGC scripts; useful for making many ad iterations |
| **Professional avatar/spokesperson ads** | **HeyGen** | Convincing avatars, voice cloning, translation, lip-sync, localization |
| **Corporate/product explainers** | **Synthesia** | Polished presenter videos, brand controls, training and B2B use cases |
| **Fast simple social ads** | **Canva** | Easiest all-in-one editor for templates, resizing, brand kits, and basic AI assistance |
| **Generative/cinematic visual ads** | **Runway** | Best when you need original visual scenes, motion graphics, product concepts, or stylized footage |
| **Script-to-video with stock footage** | **InVideo AI** | Quick for turning a prompt or script into a conventional marketing video |

### My practical recommendation

- Choose **Creatify** if you sell products online and need lots of TikTok/Reels/Meta ad variations.
- Choose **Arcads** if your winning format is creator-style testimonial or UGC advertising.
- Choose **HeyGen** if the ad needs a believable spokesperson or needs to be translated into several languages.
- Choose **Canva** if you want the simplest tool and will edit the result yourself.
- Use **Runway** alongside one of the above if your ads need unique visuals rather than stock/UGC footage.

### Important caveat

The “best” AI ad tool is usually not the one that makes the prettiest video—it is the one that helps you test the most **hooks, offers, creators, and formats** quickly. For paid ads, make 5–20 variants of the same core offer, then let performance data determine the winner.

If I had to pick just one for a typical DTC or ecommerce brand: **Creatify**.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
